first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Star-filled night sky
entities.identification: The blue-cyan star-filled sky in the upper part of the image, containing dense points of starlight and a broad, vertical, mottled bright band.

entities.name: Lake surface
entities.identification: The gray-blue to deep-blue body of water in the low area of the mountains encircling the lake, with a bright, elongated reflection on the left.

entities.name: Ridge encircling the lake
entities.identification: The dark mountains surrounding the lake, with an undulating ridgeline and steep inner mountain walls.

entities.name: Foreground rocky slope
entities.identification: The dark reddish-brown rocky-earth projection in the lower-left of the image, with a steep, jagged cliff edge.

entities.name: Evergreen thicket
entities.identification: The dark, pointed-crown thicket on the Foreground rocky slope; a fine line of small, dark trees is also visible on the distant ridge.

entities.name: Layer of fog over the lake
entities.identification: The gray-white low band of fog with soft boundaries over the left part of the Lake surface and in front of the far shore.

entities.name: Foreground dead tree and dead branches
entities.identification: The slender, leafless, gray-white to gray-brown dead trunks and bent bare branches on the Foreground rocky slope.
